description: Eclipse Wolf default look, PIXEL-SAMPLED from design/reference/eclipse_wolf-character-sheet.png (service venv PIL, python -P): the intake.json swatch chips 35,30,35 / 122,109,109 / 56,28,58 / 253,49,253 / 229,221,217 (the sixth chip 116,83,126 matches 7 drawn pixels in all three views: no surface uses it) plus direct medians of the drawn surfaces (px boxes cited per region; FRONT view unless noted). A near-black wolf with a taupe woolly fleece mantle (lighter clump tops), white narrow eyes with black pupils, a white toothy grin, dark-purple crescent horns and a dark orb. GLOW (drawn on the sheet): the horn inner-edge band, the orb ring and the four leg bands only; tiers x emission_strength 1.5 stay under the 2.0 cap.
